title: Standard10 historical/current reference reconciliation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The historical -11.4275 and exact legacy-bridge -24.5683 fresh20k results are statistically unresolved samples of the same frozen greedy policy rather than evidence of a recoverable execution-contract loss, because the bridge has exact 20,000-state action parity and the independent score-difference CI contains zero.
material_change: Read-only reconcile the two summary estimates with the audited 20,000-state exact action/slot/legality parity evidence; calculate the independent difference CI and a clearly non-goal-qualifying summary-only inverse-variance reference. No policy queries, poker hands, or training.
baseline: Historical Standard10 fresh20k -11.4275 CI[-28.7124,5.8574]; current exact bridge fresh20k -24.5683 CI[-42.8407,-6.2959], an apparent 13.1408 point gap.
notes: The historical record lacks raw hand evidence, so any pooled estimate is descriptive research context only and cannot count toward the benchmark.

result.summary: The 13.1408 bb/100 historical-minus-current point gap has an independent 95% interval [-12.0117,38.2933], both point estimates lie inside the other's interval, and the current legacy bridge already has exact action, slot, and v6-legality parity on 20,000 general states. A summary-only 40k inverse-variance reference is -17.6332 CI[-30.1901,-5.0763], but historical raw hands are unavailable and it is explicitly not formal goal evidence.
result.conclusion: There is no identified execution-contract loss to repair. The -11.4275 and -24.5683 results are compatible samples of the same frozen greedy Standard10 policy; treating the historical point as a distinct stronger deployable policy would be selection on noise.
result.next_step: Retain exact legacy-bridge Standard10 as the learned-policy anchor and use -11.4275 only as historical context. Do not spend training or Slumbot budget trying to recover a nonexistent contract difference. Return to learned-weight methods with robust multi-seed geometric evidence and sparse external calibration.
